headline: Tata Teleservices shares drop 10% after previous day's 19% rally on Q2 results
summary: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) shares fell 10% to Rs 34.24 on the NSE, giving up gains from a 19% rally in the prior session. The company reported a net loss of Rs 59 crore for Q2 FY27, which narrowed from a loss of Rs 321 crore a year ago and Rs 72 crore in the previous quarter. Despite the narrowed loss and recent volatility, the stock remains down over 30% in 2026 and 59% over three years. Retail investors holding the stock face high volatility following earnings announcements.
why_it_matters: High volatility hits retail holders despite narrowed losses.

headline: TTML reports narrower Q2 loss of ₹59 crore with revenue rising 8.2%
hook: Loss narrows as revenues tick up
summary: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) reported a consolidated net loss of ₹59.45 crore for the second quarter, narrowing from a loss of ₹312.28 crore in the same period last year. Revenue from operations rose 8.2 per cent year-on-year to ₹309.65 crore. The company's expenses stood at ₹371.14 crore for the quarter. Following the results, the stock surged 9.26 per cent to ₹35.03 on the NSE with heavy trading volumes.
why_it_matters: Quarterly loss reduction drives short-term buying in the stock
